scope: For k>=3 and r<=3*k-4, proves sum_i(|S_i|-1)<=|private union|+r+k. Combined with the prefix minterm budget and exact same-index replacement semantics, proves the original L-meta-997 refund conclusion under Eplus<=4*|Y|-3. The unrestricted L-meta-997 statement remains open.
mathematical_audit: DeficientPacking bounds the number of deficient private classes by two in the stated outside-count range.
PrivateAnd gives at least k-1 private AND gates in each deficient class; OrCompensation bounds its deficit by outside OR count minus private AND count.
The finite arithmetic lemma handles the case outside OR count<k by proving every class nondeficient; otherwise the total deficit is at most twice (outside OR count-k+1), bounded by r+k.
The weighted-sum/refund bridge reuses the checked DoubleExcess estimate and same-index NOT replacement; empty and singleton targets remain allowed.
